task.notes: Tries E23a and E23b, new2: t = 0.8.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_trend_render.what: fgw's draws and positions with every drawn cell of both brackets moved by a per-gene factor to the run profile a trend through all the task's samples gives at the target's day
fgw_trend_render.rule: trend render: each bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor to the run profile a trend through every sample of the task gives at the target's day. A sample's profile is its share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions over the labels every sample holds with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells that are extraembryonic as SERIES_RULE says (the before bracket's groups), weights the moved bracket's label shares; the trend is the least-squares line of log(profile + 1e-5) on the stage day, read at the target's day; the factor is exp(trend) / (own profile + 1e-5), rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged and clipped to 0.25-4, applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1; vec.core.apply_gene_factor). Depth is not moved: the counts outside the panel stay as released

fgw_resid.what: fgw's draws and positions with each bracket that has an earlier and a later sample moved by a per-gene factor removing the share L = 1 / (1 + w1^2 + w2^2) of its residual from the line through those two samples, at its own day
fgw_resid.rule: reference-residual render: each bracket that has, among the task's other samples (the other bracket included, the target never), an earlier and a later one has its drawn cells moved by a per-gene factor that removes the share L of its residual from the straight line through the nearest earlier and the nearest later sample by stage day. Samples, labels and profiles are TREND_RENDER_RULE's (weights the moved bracket's label shares, eps 1e-5). With d the bracket's day and d1 < d < d2 the neighbours', w1 = (d2 - d) / (d2 - d1), w2 = 1 - w1, line = w1 log(p1 + eps) + w2 log(p2 + eps), r = log(own + eps) - line, L = 1 / (1 + w1^2 + w2^2); the factor exp(-L r) is rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged and clipped to 0.25-4, applied in count space (vec.core.apply_gene_factor). A bracket without an earlier or a later sample keeps its drawn cells as released. Depth is not moved: the counts outside the panel stay as released
